summary.headline: Lunar States and Kaid
summary.text: Discussion of the six lunar states recognized by most authorities: conjunction with the lunar nodes, exaltation, fall, the luminous path, and the combust path. It also explains Kaid’s cycle, orbital placement, treatment as an inauspicious imaginary or invisible planet, and almanac notation by sign, degree, minute, and second.
